description: This file 'chainlint.pl' is a Perl script used for scanning shell scripts for test definitions and detecting problems such as broken command chains or unclosed here-docs in shell scripts. It includes modules for lexing and parsing POSIX shell scripts, as well as specific logic for analyzing test constructs within scripts, making it a source code file for a tooling project.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Perl class responsible for tokenizing POSIX shell scripts, handling string literals, operators, here-docs, and other shell syntax.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: Recursive descent parser for POSIX shell scripts with support for compound constructs such as subshells, case statements, loops, and functions.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser, with semantic knowledge of test command structures, checking for common issues such as missing '&&' or '||' and reporting problems.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions within scripts, passing test bodies through TestParser to detect issues.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for classes Lexer, ShellParser, TestParser, ScriptParser; initializes parser state.

methods.name: scan_token
methods.description: Tokenizes input buffer into shell language tokens, handling strings, operators, here-docs, and comments.

methods.name: parse_cmd
methods.description: Parses a shell command, including compound commands like loops and conditionals.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: High-level parse routine that processes tokens until a stop condition.

methods.name: parse_group
methods.description: Parses a grouped command enclosed in braces.

methods.name: parse_subshell
methods.description: Parses a subshell command enclosed in parentheses.

methods.name: check_test
methods.description: Checks a test command for issues, parses the test body, and reports problems.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Extracts the raw string content from tokens representing test bodies, including handling string literals.

methods.name: format_problem
methods.description: Formats internal problem codes into human-readable strings.
